notes: Medium. The agent must (a) bring up a live three-process stack (Go backend built from source, Python frontend, span collector) and (b) implement W3C traceparent propagation across two services plus structured JSON logging with a consistent trace_id correlation field and per-request span emission to a local collector. The interesting work is left unspecified: which files to edit and how to wire propagation are up to the agent; the verifier drives single, concurrent fan-out and failing request scenarios with fresh trace ids and asserts parent-child span linkage, trace_id consistency across every relevant log line on both services (proving cross-service propagation), and correct failure-status passthrough. hidden_case_generalization over three distinct request patterns; interaction_statefulness via the live stack and collector state; depends on an ordered bring-up; stdlib-only, so no pip deps and no resource pressure. No destructive surface.
